text:
maria: Quick sync — following up on the regional failover postmortem. We left with a handful of outstanding remediation items and I want owners/dates so we can close the loop before next game day. Meeting in 15?

alan: I'm free. I'll kick off owner assignments here. Important: we need an explicit test for routing weight smoothing to avoid the previous traffic spike.

jessica: @alan can you own routing weight smoothing test? I can help with test harness and metrics. :thumbsup:

alan: Yep, I can. Plan: add canary ramp in the routing policy, simulate cross-region failover at 50%/75%/100% weights, measure tail latency and 5xx rates. Target date: EOD Tue (1865518500).

maria: Adding that as action item.

maria: Action items (quick list, owners, target):
• routing weight smoothing test — alan — 1865518500
• verify cross-region backup integrity — kevin — 1865496000
• restore runbook v2 edits + dry-run — jessica & tom — 1865570000
• game-day dry-run (sprint window) — ops-bot coordinating — 1865650000
• postgame automation for failover rollback — alan — 1865580000

kevin: On backups: I'm going to run a checksum sweep over last 30 days' cross-region snapshots and validate S3 replication logs. I expect to find some partial failures we didn't surface. Putting a ticket in Jira: INF-7842.

maria: Please paste the ticket link when created. Also we need a clear owner for restore runbook validation — jessica will drive edits, tom will run the dry-run.

jessica: I'll push a branch `restore-runbook-v2` with high-level steps and a checklist. Example snippet:```
# Restore runbook v2 checklist
1. Confirm snapshot ID + region mapping
2. Bring up restore infra in staging region
3. Validate DB consistency using rowcount checks and hash diffs
4. Smoke test inference endpoints with sample prompts
```
I want to add an automated preflight that verifies KMS access and network peering before step 2.

tom: For the dry-run, I'll schedule a 2-hour window in staging and capture all telemetry. Can we make sure Redwood Console tracing is enabled for the run? I need token-level breakdown to verify cache warmup behavior.

maria: Yes, enable tracing and set retention to 7 days for the run. ops-bot can handle the console toggles.

ops-bot: @maria acknowledged. Creating calendar event: "Game-day dry-run — restore-runbook-v2" for 1865650000. Invitees: jessica, tom, alan, kevin, maria.

sre-bot: New follow-up created: followup/1865432100-routing-smoothing.remediation (owner: alan, due: 1865518500).

alan: One more flag — we observed a pattern in the alerts: control-plane throttles preceded the routing jitter. Propose adding backpressure metrics on the router's publish queue and two alerts: (1) queue depth > 500 for 1m, (2) publish error rate > 0.5% for 5m.

kevin: Those alerts would have caught the sequence. I'll add them to the alerting sprint and link to INF-7842 for backup correlation.

maria: Good. Also, let's avoid the "big bang" 100% cutover; prefer staged cutover with an automatic rollback on SLA breach. Add that policy to the runbook under "routing policy".

jessica: Will add a snippet to runbook:```
routing_policy:
  cutover_strategy: staged
  stages: [10, 25, 50, 75, 100]
  rollback_if:
    - latency_p95 > 800ms
    - error_rate_5xx > 1%
```

tom: For documentation audit, I'll tag all related runbooks and playbooks with `game-day-2026` label so we can find them during postmortem windows.

maria: Great. Last thing: recurring incident patterns — ops-bot, can you generate a 90-day incident trend for regional failover-related alerts and post here? I want to see frequency and overlap with deploys.

ops-bot: Generating report... done. Link: https://console.internal/redwood/reports/regions/failover-90d (requires SSO). Summary: 7 incidents in 90d, 4 correlated with deploys, 3 with backup replication lag.

maria: Thanks. Action: compile a short retro note with the owners/dates and stitch into the next all-hands slides. I'll own that write-up. Target for the slide: 1865590000.

alan: I'll update follow-up ticket with validation results when done.

kevin: Backup verification ticket INF-7842 created: https://jira.internal/INF-7842. Assigning to @kevin.

maria: Perfect. If no objections, we'll treat these as committed owners/dates and track in the remediation board. If anything slips, call it out in-thread. Closing the quick sync now — thanks all. :shipit:
